verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a management API and publishes an LLM-oriented markdown API reference (`_llms/api-reference.md`), so agents can ingest a text description of the API. However, no OpenAPI or equivalent schema file is evidenced, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger (or equivalent structured schema) file, documentation pointing to where a spec can be fetched, and independent confirmation of spec-based tooling or client generation.
